data.name: Beastly Soccer
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

When the ticket prices for the 2026 World Cup skyrocket beyond anything a normal fan could ever afford, two unlikely heroes — Pollito, the fearless little chick, and Xiang Xiang, the gentle but competitive panda — decide the world deserves a tournament everyone can enjoy. Their solution is simple: Create a brand‑new World Cup… run entirely by animals.

Beastly Soccer is an over‑the‑top arcade soccer brawler inspired by classics like Kunio‑kun and Super Mario Strikers. Cute creatures, chaotic arenas, elemental super‑shots, and nonstop action come together to create a wild, unpredictable version of the beautiful game.

Choose one of 10 Beastly captains, each with unique abilities and devastating Super Shoots, and represent any of the 48 national teams that qualified for the real 2026 World Cup. Fire spirals, electric volleys, icy curveballs, explosive bomb shots — every match is a spectacle.

FEATURES

🐾 10 Playable Beastly Heroes Each captain has their own stats, playstyle, and special moves. Master their abilities to dominate the field with style.

🌍 48 National Teams from the 2026 World Cup Pick your country and lead it to glory in the Beastly World Cup — a wild, animal‑powered parody of the real tournament.

🏟️ Six Hazard‑Filled Stadiums Every arena is a dangerous playground featuring:

  • Electrified water zones

  • Jumpable mountain ridges

  • Wind tunnels and moving terrain

  • Random elemental power‑ups (Fire, Ice, Electricity, Bomb)

No two matches ever play the same.

📖 Story Mode Based on the 2026 World Cup Follow the full tournament bracket, reimagined through the eyes of Pollito, Xiang Xiang, and their squad of animal athletes. Expect comedy, rivalries, and plenty of chaos.

⚡ Fast, Arcade‑Heavy Gameplay This isn’t a simulation — it’s a brawl disguised as soccer. Big hits, wild physics, and explosive super‑shots define every match.

🎮 Local Multiplayer Madness Play locally with friends. Team up, face off, or create chaotic 2v2 battles where super‑shots fly every few seconds.
